_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-08 18:02:37Z)**_

Here's **issue #19** from your team repo, `CSCI-435-SE/cal.diy` (the `origin` remote points to upstream calcom, where #19 is an old closed i18n thread):

**[#19 Allow users to set a custom default landing page after login](https://github.com/CSCI-435-SE/cal.diy/issues/19)**
- **State:** Open · **Label:** `effort:medium` · **Author:** kojoshuay · **Assignee:** you (julissaehp) · No comments yet

**User story:** As a user, I want to choose which page I land on after logging in (for example, Bookings), so I don't have to navigate there every time.

**Scenario:** Right now users always land on the Event Types page. The user opens account Settings, finds a new "default home view" dropdown, switches it from "Event Types" to "Bookings", and the next login takes them straight to Bookings.

**Acceptance criteria:**
1. Add a dropdown to the account settings UI for choosing the default home view.
2. It offers at least "Event Types", "Bookings" and "Availability".
3. The choice is saved to the user's schema/profile.
4. After login, the user goes to their chosen page instead of the fixed Event Types redirect.

**Out of scope:** Building new pages to land on, and org-wide or workspace-wide defaults. This is only a per-user setting.

**Open question:** Should new accounts keep defaulting to Event Types until they change the setting?

**Before starting:** Criterion 3 needs a change to `schema.prisma` (a new field on `User` plus a migration), and the project rules say to ask before making schema changes. You're also on `fix/reschedule-reason-frontend` right now, so you'll want a new branch off `main`.

If you'd like, I can look at where the post-login redirect and the general settings form live and propose a plan.

---

```text
import { createRouterCaller } from "app/_trpc/context";
import { _generateMetadata } from "app/_utils";
import { cookies, headers } from "next/headers";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { getServerSession } from "@calcom/features/auth/lib/getServerSession";
import { meRouter } from "@calcom/trpc/server/routers/viewer/me/_router";
import { getTravelSchedule } from "@calcom/web/app/cache/travelSchedule";

import { buildLegacyRequest } from "@lib/buildLegacyCtx";

import GeneralView from "~/settings/my-account/general-view";

export const generateMetadata = async () =>
  await _generateMetadata(
    (t) => t("general"),
    (t) => t("general_description"),
    undefined,
    undefined,
    "/settings/my-account/general"
  );

const Page = async () => {
  const session = await getServerSession({ req: buildLegacyRequest(await headers(), await cookies()) });
  const userId = session?.user?.id;
  const redirectUrl = "/auth/login?callbackUrl=/settings/my-account/general";

  if (!userId) {
    return redirect(redirectUrl);
  }

  const meCaller = await createRouterCaller(meRouter);
  const [user, travelSchedules] = await Promise.all([meCaller.get(), getTravelSchedule(userId)]);
  if (!user) {
    redirect(redirectUrl);
  }
  return <GeneralView user={user} travelSchedules={travelSchedules ?? []} />;
};

export default Page;
```

```text
    id?: number;

    startDate: Date;
  }[];

    id: number;
    email: string;
    isDeleted?: boolean;

};

export type TUpdateProfileInputSchema = {
  username?: string;
  name?: string;
  email?: string;
  bio?: string;
  avatarUrl?: string | null;
  timeZone?: string;
  weekStart?: string;
  hideBranding?: boolean;
  allowDynamicBooking?: boolean;
  allowSEOIndexing?: boolean;
  receiveMonthlyDigestEmail?: boolean;
  requiresBookerEmailVerification?: boolean;
  brandColor?: string;
  darkBrandColor?: string;
  theme?: string | null;
  appTheme?: string | null;
  completedOnboarding?: boolean;
  locale?: string;
  timeFormat?: number;
  metadata?: z.infer<typeof userMetadata>;
  travelSchedules?: {
    id?: number;
    timeZone: string;
    endDate?: Date;
    startDate: Date;
  }[];
  secondaryEmails?: {
    id: number;
    email: string;
    isDeleted: boolean;
  }[];
};

export const ZUpdateProfileInputSchema: z.ZodType<
  TUpdateProfileInputSchema,
  z.ZodTypeDef,
  TUpdateProfileInputSchemaInput
> = z.object({
  username: z.string().optional(),
  name: z.string().max(FULL_NAME_LENGTH_MAX_LIMIT).optional(),
  email: z.string().optional(),
  bio: z.string().optional(),
  avatarUrl: z.string().nullable().optional(),
  timeZone: timeZoneSchema.optional(),
  weekStart: z.string().optional(),
  hideBranding: z.boolean().optional(),

  allowSEOIndexing: z.boolean().optional(),
  receiveMonthlyDigestEmail: z.boolean().optional(),
  requiresBookerEmailVerification: z.boolean().optional(),
  brandColor: z.string().optional(),
  darkBrandColor: z.string().optional(),
  theme: z.string().optional().nullable(),
  appTheme: z.string().optional().nullable(),
  completedOnboarding: z.boolean().optional(),
  locale: z.string().optional(),
  timeFormat: z.number().optional(),
  metadata: userMetadata.optional(),

    .array(

        id: z.number().optional(),
        timeZone: timeZoneSchema,
        endDate: z.date().optional(),
        startDate: z.date(),

    .array(

        id: z.number(),

    .optional(),
});
```

```text
export const updateProfileHandler = async ({ ctx, input }: UpdateProfileOptions) => {
  const { user } = ctx;

  const locale = input.locale || user.locale;

  const emailVerification = await featuresRepository.checkIfFeatureIsEnabledGlobally("email-verification");

  const { travelSchedules, ...rest } = input;

  const secondaryEmails = input?.secondaryEmails || [];
  delete input.secondaryEmails;

  const data: Prisma.UserUpdateInput = {
    ...rest,
    metadata: userMetadata,
    secondaryEmails: undefined,
  };

  let isPremiumUsername = false;

      name: true,
      createdDate: true,
      avatarUrl: true,
      locale: true,
      schedules: {
        select: {
          id: true,
        },
      },
    },
  } satisfies Prisma.UserDefaultArgs;

  // Explicit type to avoid Prisma.UserGetPayload conditional types leaking into .d.ts files
  type UpdatedUserResult = {
    id: number;
    username: string | null;
    email: string;
    identityProvider: string | null;
    identityProviderId: string | null;
    metadata: JsonValue;
    name: string | null;
    createdDate: Date;
    avatarUrl: string | null;
    locale: string | null;
    schedules: { id: number }[];
  };

  let updatedUser: UpdatedUserResult;

  try {
    updatedUser = await prisma.user.update({
      where: {
        id: user.id,

      data,
      ...updatedUserSelect,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    // Catch unique constraint failure on email field.
    if (e instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && e.code === "P2002") {
      const meta = e.meta as { target: string[] };
      if (meta.target.indexOf("email") !== -1) {
        throw new HttpError({ statusCode: 409, message: "email_already_used" });
      }
    }
    throw e; // make sure other errors are rethrown
  }

    sendEmailVerification: emailVerification && !secondaryEmail?.emailVerified,

};

const cleanMetadataAllowedUpdateKeys = (metadata: TUpdateProfileInputSchema["metadata"]) => {
  if (!metadata) {
    return {};
  }
  const cleanedMetadata = updateUserMetadataAllowedKeys.safeParse(metadata);
  if (!cleanedMetadata.success) {
    logger.error("Error cleaning metadata", cleanedMetadata.error);
    return {};
  }

  return cleanedMetadata.data;
};

const handleUserMetadata = ({ ctx, input }: UpdateProfileOptions) => {
  const { user } = ctx;
  const cleanMetadata = cleanMetadataAllowedUpdateKeys(input.metadata);
  const userMetadata = userMetadataSchema.parse(user.metadata);
  // Required so we don't override and delete saved values
  return { ...userMetadata, ...cleanMetadata };
};
```

```text
import { cookies, headers } from "next/headers";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { checkOnboardingRedirect } from "@calcom/features/auth/lib/onboardingUtils";
import { getServerSession } from "@calcom/features/auth/lib/getServerSession";

import { buildLegacyRequest } from "@lib/buildLegacyCtx";

const RedirectPage = async () => {
  const session = await getServerSession({ req: buildLegacyRequest(await headers(), await cookies()) });

  if (!session?.user?.id) {
    redirect("/auth/login");
  }

  // Check if user needs onboarding and redirect before going to event-types
  const organizationId = session.user.profile?.organizationId ?? null;
  const onboardingPath = await checkOnboardingRedirect(session.user.id, {
    checkEmailVerification: true,
    organizationId,
  });
  if (onboardingPath) {
    redirect(onboardingPath);
  }

  redirect("/event-types");
};

export default RedirectPage;
    iCalUID: z.string().optional(),

});

    stripeCustomerId: z.string().optional(),
    vitalSettings: vitalSettingsUpdateSchema.optional(),
```

```text
import { bookerLayoutOptions, type BookerLayoutSettings } from "@calcom/prisma/zod-utils";

export const validateBookerLayouts = (settings: BookerLayoutSettings) => {
  // Allow layouts to be null, as per database defaults.
  if (settings === null) return;

  // At least one layout should be enabled.
  const atLeastOneLayoutIsEnabled = settings?.enabledLayouts.length > 0;
  if (!atLeastOneLayoutIsEnabled) return "bookerlayout_error_min_one_enabled";

  // Default layout should also be enabled.
  const defaultLayoutIsInEnabledLayouts = settings?.enabledLayouts.find(
    (layout) => layout === settings.defaultLayout
  );
```

```typescript
import type { DefaultLandingPage } from "@calcom/prisma/zod-utils";
import { userMetadata } from "@calcom/prisma/zod-utils";

export const DEFAULT_LANDING_PAGE: DefaultLandingPage = "event-types";

export const defaultLandingPagePaths: Record<DefaultLandingPage, string> = {
  "event-types": "/event-types",
  // /bookings has no index route; "upcoming" is the tab the main nav links to
  bookings: "/bookings/upcoming",
  availability: "/availability",
};

export const getDefaultLandingPage = (metadata: unknown): DefaultLandingPage => {
  // safeParse so malformed metadata can never block a user from reaching the app after login
  const parsed = userMetadata.safeParse(metadata);
  if (!parsed.success) return DEFAULT_LANDING_PAGE;
  return parsed.data?.defaultLandingPage ?? DEFAULT_LANDING_PAGE;
};

export const getDefaultLandingPagePath = (metadata: unknown): string =>
  defaultLandingPagePaths[getDefaultLandingPage(metadata)];
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { getDefaultLandingPage, getDefaultLandingPagePath } from "./defaultLandingPage";

describe("getDefaultLandingPagePath", () => {
  it("returns /event-types when the user chose Event Types", () => {
    expect(getDefaultLandingPagePath({ defaultLandingPage: "event-types" })).toBe("/event-types");
  });

  it("returns /bookings/upcoming when the user chose Bookings", () => {
    expect(getDefaultLandingPagePath({ defaultLandingPage: "bookings" })).toBe("/bookings/upcoming");
  });

  it("returns /availability when the user chose Availability", () => {
    expect(getDefaultLandingPagePath({ defaultLandingPage: "availability" })).toBe("/availability");
  });

  describe("falls back to /event-types", () => {
    it("when metadata is null", () => {
      expect(getDefaultLandingPagePath(null)).toBe("/event-types");
    });

    it("when metadata is undefined", () => {
      expect(getDefaultLandingPagePath(undefined)).toBe("/event-types");
    });

    it("when metadata has no saved preference", () => {
      expect(getDefaultLandingPagePath({ sessionTimeout: 30 })).toBe("/event-types");
    });

    it("when the saved preference is not a supported page", () => {
      expect(getDefaultLandingPagePath({ defaultLandingPage: "insights" })).toBe("/event-types");
    });

    it("when metadata is not an object", () => {
      expect(getDefaultLandingPagePath("bookings")).toBe("/event-types");
    });
  });
});

describe("getDefaultLandingPage", () => {
  it("keeps other metadata keys from affecting the result", () => {
    expect(
      getDefaultLandingPage({ sessionTimeout: 30, isPremium: true, defaultLandingPage: "availability" })
    ).toBe("availability");
  });

  it("returns event-types when no preference is saved", () => {
    expect(getDefaultLandingPage({})).toBe("event-types");
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { cookies, headers } from "next/headers";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { checkOnboardingRedirect } from "@calcom/features/auth/lib/onboardingUtils";
import { getServerSession } from "@calcom/features/auth/lib/getServerSession";
import { getUserRepository } from "@calcom/features/di/containers/UserRepository";
import { getDefaultLandingPagePath } from "@calcom/lib/defaultLandingPage";

import { buildLegacyRequest } from "@lib/buildLegacyCtx";

const RedirectPage = async () => {
  const session = await getServerSession({ req: buildLegacyRequest(await headers(), await cookies()) });

  if (!session?.user?.id) {
    redirect("/auth/login");
  }

  // Check if user needs onboarding and redirect before going to their landing page
  const organizationId = session.user.profile?.organizationId ?? null;
  const onboardingPath = await checkOnboardingRedirect(session.user.id, {
    checkEmailVerification: true,
    organizationId,
  });
  if (onboardingPath) {
    redirect(onboardingPath);
  }

  const user = await getUserRepository().findMetadataById({ id: session.user.id });
  redirect(getDefaultLandingPagePath(user?.metadata));
};

export default RedirectPage;

```

I've implemented #19 on `feat/custom-default-landing-page`. Nothing is committed or pushed, and there are no Prisma schema or migration changes. The 10 new unit tests pass and `tsc` on `apps/web` finds 0 type errors. I haven't tried it in the running app yet.

## 1–2. Files changed

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `packages/prisma/zod-utils.ts` | Adds the three allowed values (`event-types`, `bookings`, `availability`) and an optional `defaultLandingPage` key in the user's metadata. This only changes validation code, not the database. |
| `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/me/updateProfile.schema.ts` | Allows `defaultLandingPage` through the existing `updateProfile` flow. Without this, the handler silently drops the key. The handler already merges new keys into saved metadata, so other saved values are kept. |
| `packages/lib/defaultLandingPage.ts` *(new)* | Turns a user's metadata into a page: Event Types → `/event-types`, Bookings → `/bookings/upcoming` (there's no plain `/bookings` page), Availability → `/availability`. A missing, invalid or unreadable value falls back to `/event-types`, so bad data can't stop someone from getting in after login. |
| `packages/lib/defaultLandingPage.test.ts` *(new)* | Tests for that logic (see section 3). |
| `packages/features/users/repositories/UserRepository.ts` | Adds `findMetadataById`, which reads only the `metadata` column. The existing `findById` loads the whole user and throws on bad metadata, which is too much for a check that runs on every login. |
| `apps/web/app/page.tsx` | The onboarding check still runs first, unchanged. The fixed `redirect("/event-types")` now goes to the user's saved page, read through the repository's standard access function. |
| `apps/web/modules/settings/my-account/general-view.tsx` | Adds a "Default landing page" dropdown under Start of week, with a short hint. It loads the saved choice (Event Types if none) and saves through the existing Update button. |
| `packages/i18n/locales/en/common.json` | Adds 2 strings: `default_landing_page` and `default_landing_page_hint`. The option names reuse existing translations. |

That's 8 files, +138/−4 lines. I didn't touch the signup, verify-email and onboarding redirects, or the logo and return-home links.

One behavior to know: a link with an explicit `callbackUrl` (for example, a bookmarked bookings URL) still takes priority over the saved preference.

## 3. Tests and checks

- **Unit tests:** `TZ=UTC yarn vitest run packages/lib/defaultLandingPage.test.ts` → **10/10 passed**. They cover:
  - each of the three choices going to the right page;
  - falling back to `/event-types` for null or undefined metadata, no saved preference, an unsupported value like `"insights"`, and metadata that isn't an object;
  - other metadata keys not affecting the result.
- **Type check:** `yarn type-check:ci --force` doesn't run on this Windows setup: Turbo fails with `spawn tsc ENOENT` in every package, and the log has no TypeScript errors at all. Instead I ran `tsc --noEmit` directly on `apps/web`, which pulls in the other changed files → **exit 0, 0 errors**.
- **Biome:** No new lint errors.
  - My new test file's import order was flagged and is fixed.
  - `page.tsx` and `UserRepository.ts` have import-order errors that were already there before my change; I left them alone to keep the diff small.
  - Biome also reports a formatting error on every file because this Windows checkout uses CRLF line endings, not because of these edits.

**Not done:**
- No component or E2E test for the dropdown or the redirect page itself.
- No click-through in the running app. If you want, I can start the app to try it out.

Thanks for testing #19 and opening the PR. Here's **issue #51**:

**[#51 Add a rebook feature](https://github.com/CSCI-435-SE/cal.diy/issues/51)**
- **State:** Open · **Labels:** `enhancement`, `effort:low` · **Author:** Demir Beynam (dbbeynam) · **Assignee:** you · No comments yet

**Problem:** cal.diy forgets the people you've met once a booking ends.

**User story:** As someone with recurring 1:1s, I want to rebook last month's person without retyping their name and email.

**Proposed solution, in two parts:**
1. **"Book again" on past bookings:** opens the booking page with the attendee's details already filled in. The issue stresses this is different from rescheduling: it creates a new booking and leaves the old one alone.
2. **A "People" view:** a list of everyone you've met, with how often, when you last met, and one click to schedule the next meeting.

**House rules:** The issue template says not to start coding while a `🚨 needs approval` label is on it. #51 doesn't have that label, so you're clear to start.

**Things worth settling before coding:**
- **Scope vs. `effort:low`:** "Book again" fits a low-effort label. The People view needs a new page, a new query that groups attendees across your bookings, and navigation. It probably deserves its own issue or PR, in line with the repo's small-PR rule.
- **Which event type "Book again" uses:** the same event type as the past booking is the obvious default. It's unclear what should happen if that event type was deleted or hidden.
- **Which attendee gets pre-filled:** a past booking can have several attendees or guests. Pre-fill the main attendee only, or add the others as guests too?

If you'd like, I can look at how the past bookings list and booking-page pre-filling (the `name`/`email` URL parameters) work today and propose a plan, probably starting with "Book again" alone.

<pasted_content id="9f44">
## Sub-Issue 1 — Add "Book Again" Functionality to Past Bookings

### User Story
As a user, I want to quickly book another meeting with someone from a past booking so that I do not have to manually re-enter their information.

### User Scenario
When viewing a past booking, the user can choose to book another meeting with the same attendee. The application starts a new booking flow and automatically fills in the attendee's existing name and email. The user can then choose a new date and time and complete the booking normally. The original booking remains unchanged because booking again creates a separate booking rather than rescheduling the previous one.

### Acceptance Criteria
1. Add a "Book Again" action to past bookings.
2. Clicking "Book Again" starts a new booking flow rather than modifying or rescheduling the original booking.
3. Automatically prefill the previous attendee's:
   - Name
   - Email
4. Allow the user to review or edit the prefilled attendee information before confirming the new booking.
5. Allow the user to select a new available date and time using the existing booking flow.
6. Successfully completing the flow creates a new booking while leaving the original booking unchanged.
7. Add or update tests to verify the rebooking behavior and ensure existing booking and rescheduling functionality continues to work.

### Out of Scope
- Building a People view of previous attendees.
- Displaying meeting counts or previous meeting history.
- Changing the existing rescheduling workflow.
- Automatically selecting a new meeting date or time.

## Sub-Issue 2 — Add People View for Previous Attendees

### User Story
As a user, I want to see the people I have previously met with so that I can review my meeting history and easily schedule another meeting with them.

### User Scenario
The system uses the user's previous bookings to create a People view containing the attendees they have met with. Instead of showing the same person multiple times, each attendee appears once with useful information about their meeting history, including how many times they have met and their most recent meeting. From this view, the user can start the Book Again flow for that person.

### Acceptance Criteria
1. Add a People view that displays attendees from the user's previous bookings.
2. Display each attendee's:
   - Name
   - Email
   - Number of previous meetings
   - Most recent meeting date
3. Display an attendee only once when multiple previous bookings exist with the same person.
4. Calculate the total number of previous meetings for each attendee.
5. Determine and display the most recent meeting date for each attendee.
6. Add a "Book Again" action for each person that uses the rebooking functionality created in Sub-Issue 1.
7. Display an appropriate empty state when the user does not have any previous attendees.
8. Add or update tests to verify attendee grouping, meeting counts, most recent meeting dates, and the People view behavior.

### Out of Scope
- Creating a separate contacts or address book system.
- Allowing users to manually add people who have never had a booking.
- Editing an attendee's personal information from the People view.
- Changing existing bookings or rescheduling behavior.

7. Any database/schema/API changes you believe are necessary, and why.
8. Any risks, edge cases, or questions that should be resolved before coding.
9. Confirmation that the two sub-issues can remain separate PRs and whether Sub-Issue 2 can cleanly build on Sub-Issue 1.

Do not implement anything yet. Wait for my approval after presenting the plan.

```text
  @@index([type])
  @@index([uid])

model Attendee {
  id          Int          @id @default(autoincrement())
  email       String
  name        String
  timeZone    String
  phoneNumber String?
  locale      String?      @default("en")
  booking     Booking?     @relation(fields: [bookingId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  bookingId   Int?
  bookingSeat BookingSeat?
  noShow      Boolean?     @default(false)

  @@index([email])
  @@index([bookingId])
  @@index([email, bookingId])
}

enum BookingStatus {
  CANCELLED     @map("cancelled")
  ACCEPTED      @map("accepted")
  REJECTED      @map("rejected")
  PENDING       @map("pending")
  AWAITING_HOST @map("awaiting_host")
}

model Booking {
  id                     Int                        @id @default(autoincrement())
  uid                    String                     @unique
  // (optional) UID based on slot start/end time & email against duplicates
  idempotencyKey         String?                    @unique
  user                   User?                      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  userId                 Int?
  // User's email at the time of booking
  /// @zod.import(["import { emailSchema } from '../../zod-utils'"]).custom.use(emailSchema)
  userPrimaryEmail       String?
  references             BookingReference[]
  eventType              EventType?                 @relation(fields: [eventTypeId], references: [id])
  eventTypeId            Int?
  title                  String
  description            String?
  customInputs           Json?
  /// @zod.import(["import { bookingResponses } from '../../zod-utils'"]).custom.use(bookingResponses)
  responses              Json?
  startTime              DateTime
  endTime                DateTime
  attendees              Attendee[]
  location               String?
  createdAt              DateTime                   @default(now())
  updatedAt              DateTime?                  @updatedAt
  status                 BookingStatus              @default(ACCEPTED)
  paid                   Boolean                    @default(false)
  payment                Payment[]
  destinationCalendar    DestinationCalendar?       @relation(fields: [destinationCalendarId], references: [id])
  destinationCalendarId  Int?
  cancellationReason     String?
  rejectionReason        String?
  reassignReason         String?
  reassignBy             User?                      @relation("reassignByUser", fields: [reassignById], references: [id])
  reassignById           Int?
  dynamicEventSlugRef    String?
  dynamicGroupSlugRef    String?
  rescheduled            Boolean?
  fromReschedule         String?
  recurringEventId       String?
  smsReminderNumber      String?
  scheduledJobs          String[] // scheduledJobs is deprecated, please use scheduledTriggers instead
  seatsReferences        BookingSeat[]
  /// @zod.import(["import { bookingMetadataSchema } from '../../zod-utils'"]).custom.use(bookingMetadataSchema)
  metadata               Json?
  isRecorded             Boolean                    @default(false)
  iCalUID                String?                    @default("")
  iCalSequence           Int                        @default(0)
  instantMeetingToken    InstantMeetingToken?
  rating                 Int?
  ratingFeedback         String?
  noShowHost             Boolean?                   @default(false)
  scheduledTriggers      WebhookScheduledTriggers[]
  oneTimePassword        String?                    @unique @default(uuid())
  /// @zod.import(["import { emailSchema } from '../../zod-utils'"]).custom.use(emailSchema)
  cancelledBy            String?
  /// @zod.import(["import { emailSchema } from '../../zod-utils'"]).custom.use(emailSchema)
  rescheduledBy          String?
  assignmentReason       AssignmentReason[]
  internalNote           BookingInternalNote[]
  creationSource         CreationSource?
  tracking               Tracking?
  expenseLogs            CreditExpenseLog[]
  report                 BookingReport?
  wrongAssignmentReports WrongAssignmentReport[]

  // @@partial_index([reassignById])

  @@index([eventTypeId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([destinationCalendarId])
  @@index([recurringEventId])
  @@index([uid])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([startTime, endTime, status])
  @@index([fromReschedule])
  @@index([userId, endTime])
  @@index([userId, status, startTime])
  @@index([eventTypeId, status])
  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}

model Tracking {
  id           Int     @id @default(autoincrement())
  bookingId    Int
  booking      Booking @relation(fields: [bookingId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  utm_source   String?
  utm_medium   String?
```

```text
229	export function isActionDisabled(actionId: string, context: BookingActionContext): boolean {
230	  const {
231	    booking,
232	    isBookingInPast,
233	    isDisabledRescheduling,
234	    isDisabledCancelling,
235	    isAttendee,
236	    isCancelled,
237	    isRejected,
238	  } = context;
239	
240	  switch (actionId) {
241	    case "reschedule":
242	    case "reschedule_request":
243	      // Only apply minimum reschedule notice restriction if user is NOT the organizer
244	      // If user is an attendee (or not authenticated), apply the restriction
245	      const isUserOrganizer =
246	        !isAttendee &&
247	        booking.loggedInUser?.userId &&
248	        booking.user?.id &&
249	        booking.loggedInUser.userId === booking.user.id;
250	      const isWithinMinimumNotice =
251	        !isUserOrganizer &&
252	        isWithinMinimumRescheduleNotice(
253	          new Date(booking.startTime),
254	          booking.eventType.minimumRescheduleNotice ?? null
255	        );
256	      return (
257	        isCancelled ||
258	        isRejected ||
259	        (isBookingInPast && !booking.eventType.allowReschedulingPastBookings) ||
260	        isDisabledRescheduling ||
261	        isWithinMinimumNotice
262	      );
263	    case "cancel":
264	      return isDisabledCancelling || isBookingInPast || isCancelled || isRejected;
265	    case "view_recordings":
266	      return !(isBookingInPast && booking.status === BookingStatus.ACCEPTED && context.isCalVideoLocation);
267	    case "meeting_session_details":
268	      return !(isBookingInPast && booking.status === BookingStatus.ACCEPTED && context.isCalVideoLocation);
269	    case "charge_card":
270	      return context.cardCharged;
271	    case "reassign":
272	    case "change_location":
273	    case "add_members":
274	      return isBookingInPast || isCancelled || isRejected;
275	    default:
276	      return false;
277	  }
278	}
279	
280	export function getActionLabel(actionId: string, context: BookingActionContext): string {
281	  const { isTabRecurring, isRecurring, attendeeList, cardCharged, t } = context;
282	
283	  switch (actionId) {
284	    case "reject":
285	      return (isTabRecurring || context.isTabUnconfirmed) && isRecurring ? t("reject_all") : t("reject");
286	    case "confirm":
287	      return (isTabRecurring || context.isTabUnconfirmed) && isRecurring ? t("confirm_all") : t("confirm");
288	    case "cancel":
289	      return isTabRecurring && isRecurring ? t("cancel_all_remaining") : t("cancel_event");
290	    case "no_show":
291	      return attendeeList.length === 1 && attendeeList[0].noShow
292	        ? t("unmark_as_no_show")
293	        : t("mark_as_no_show");
294	    case "charge_card":
295	      return cardCharged ? t("no_show_fee_charged") : t("collect_no_show_fee");
296	    default:
297	      return t(actionId);
298	  }
299	}
```

```text
5	import { Button } from "@calcom/ui/components/button";
6	import { Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogFooter } from "@calcom/ui/components/dialog";
7	import {
8	  Dropdown,
9	  DropdownItem,
10	  DropdownMenuContent,
11	  DropdownMenuItem,
12	  DropdownMenuLabel,
13	  DropdownMenuPortal,
14	  DropdownMenuSeparator,
15	  DropdownMenuTrigger,
16	} from "@calcom/ui/components/dropdown";
17	import type { ActionType } from "@calcom/ui/components/table";
18	import { showToast } from "@calcom/ui/components/toast";
19	import { Tooltip } from "@calcom/ui/components/tooltip";
20	import { AddGuestsDialog } from "@components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog";
21	import { CancelBookingDialog } from "@components/dialog/CancelBookingDialog";
22	import { ChargeCardDialog } from "@components/dialog/ChargeCardDialog";
23	import { EditLocationDialog } from "@components/dialog/EditLocationDialog";
24	import { ReassignDialog } from "@components/dialog/ReassignDialog";
25	import { RejectionReasonDialog } from "@components/dialog/RejectionReasonDialog";
26	import { ReportBookingDialog } from "@components/dialog/ReportBookingDialog";
27	import { RescheduleDialog } from "@components/dialog/RescheduleDialog";
28	import { WrongAssignmentDialog } from "@components/dialog/WrongAssignmentDialog";
29	import { useState } from "react";
30	import type { z } from "zod";
31	import { useBookingConfirmation } from "../hooks/useBookingConfirmation";
32	import type { BookingItemProps } from "../types";
33	import { useBookingActionsStoreContext } from "./BookingActionsStoreProvider";
34	import {
35	  type BookingActionContext,
36	  getAfterEventActions,
37	  getCancelEventAction,
38	  getEditEventActions,
39	  getPendingActions,
40	  getReportAction,
41	  shouldShowEditActions,
42	  shouldShowPendingActions,
43	} from "./bookingActions";
44	
45	interface BookingActionsDropdownProps {
46	  booking: BookingItemProps;
47	  size?: "xs" | "sm" | "base" | "lg";
48	  className?: string;
49	  /**
50	   * Whether to use a portal for the dropdown menu.
51	   * Set to false when rendering inside a Sheet/Dialog to keep the dropdown within the modal's stacking context.
52	   * @default true
53	   */
54	  usePortal?: boolean;
55	  /**
56	   * Context where the dropdown is being used.
57	   * - "list": Used in booking list view (hides Confirm and Reject actions)
58	   * - "details": Used in booking details view (shows all actions)
59	   */
60	  context: "list" | "details";
61	}
62	
63	export function BookingActionsDropdown({
64	  booking,
65	  size = "base",
66	  className,
67	  usePortal = true,
68	  context,
69	}: BookingActionsDropdownProps) {
70	  const { t } = useLocale();
71	  const utils = trpc.useUtils();
72	
73	  const isRecurring = booking.recurringEventId !== null;
74	  const isTabRecurring = booking.listingStatus === "recurring";
75	  const isTabUnconfirmed = booking.listingStatus === "unconfirmed";
76	
77	  // Use the booking confirmation hook for confirm/reject logic
78	  const {
79	    bookingConfirm,
80	    handleReject,
81	    rejectionDialogIsOpen,
82	    setRejectionDialogIsOpen,
83	    isPending: isConfirmPending,
84	  } = useBookingConfirmation({
85	    isRecurring,
86	    isTabRecurring,
87	    isTabUnconfirmed,
88	  });
89	
90	  // Use store for all other dialog states
91	  const chargeCardDialogIsOpen = useBookingActionsStoreContext((state) => state.chargeCardDialogIsOpen);
92	  const setChargeCardDialogIsOpen = useBookingActionsStoreContext((state) => state.setChargeCardDialogIsOpen);
93	  const viewRecordingsDialogIsOpen = useBookingActionsStoreContext(
94	    (state) => state.viewRecordingsDialogIsOpen
95	  );
96	  const setViewRecordingsDialogIsOpen = useBookingActionsStoreContext(
97	    (state) => state.setViewRecordingsDialogIsOpen
98	  );
99	  const meetingSessionDetailsDialogIsOpen = useBookingActionsStoreContext(
100	    (state) => state.meetingSessionDetailsDialogIsOpen
101	  );
102	  const setMeetingSessionDetailsDialogIsOpen = useBookingActionsStoreContext(
103	    (state) => state.setMeetingSessionDetailsDialogIsOpen
104	  );
105	  const isNoShowDialogOpen = useBookingActionsStoreContext((state) => state.isNoShowDialogOpen);
106	  const setIsNoShowDialogOpen = useBookingActionsStoreContext((state) => state.setIsNoShowDialogOpen);
107	  const isOpenRescheduleDialog = useBookingActionsStoreContext((state) => state.isOpenRescheduleDialog);
108	  const setIsOpenRescheduleDialog = useBookingActionsStoreContext((state) => state.setIsOpenRescheduleDialog);
109	  const isOpenReassignDialog = useBookingActionsStoreContext((state) => state.isOpenReassignDialog);
110	  const setIsOpenReassignDialog = useBookingActionsStoreContext((state) => state.setIsOpenReassignDialog);
111	  const isOpenSetLocationDialog = useBookingActionsStoreContext((state) => state.isOpenSetLocationDialog);
112	  const setIsOpenLocationDialog = useBookingActionsStoreContext((state) => state.setIsOpenLocationDialog);
113	  const isOpenAddGuestsDialog = useBookingActionsStoreContext((state) => state.isOpenAddGuestsDialog);
114	  const setIsOpenAddGuestsDialog = useBookingActionsStoreContext((state) => state.setIsOpenAddGuestsDialog);
115	  const isOpenReportDialog = useBookingActionsStoreContext((state) => state.isOpenReportDialog);
116	  const setIsOpenReportDialog = useBookingActionsStoreContext((state) => state.setIsOpenReportDialog);
117	  const isOpenWrongAssignmentDialog = useBookingActionsStoreContext(
118	    (state) => state.isOpenWrongAssignmentDialog
119	  );
120	  const setIsOpenWrongAssignmentDialog = useBookingActionsStoreContext(
121	    (state) => state.setIsOpenWrongAssignmentDialog
122	  );
123	  const isCancelDialogOpen = useBookingActionsStoreContext((state) => state.isCancelDialogOpen);
124	  const setIsCancelDialogOpen = useBookingActionsStoreContext((state) => state.setIsCancelDialogOpen);
125	
126	  const cardCharged = booking?.payment[0]?.success;
127	
128	  const attendeeList = booking.attendees.map((attendee) => {
129	    return {
130	      name: attendee.name,
131	      email: attendee.email,
132	      id: attendee.id,
133	      noShow: attendee.noShow || false,
134	      phoneNumber: attendee.phoneNumber,
135	    };
136	  });
137	
138	  const noShowMutation = trpc.viewer.loggedInViewerRouter.markNoShow.useMutation({
139	    onSuccess: async (data) => {
140	      showToast(data.message, "success");
141	      await utils.viewer.bookings.invalidate();
142	    },
143	    onError: (err) => {
144	      showToast(err.message, "error");
145	    },
146	  });
147	
148	  const setLocationMutation = trpc.viewer.bookings.editLocation.useMutation({
149	    onSuccess: () => {
150	      showToast(t("location_updated"), "success");
151	      setIsOpenLocationDialog(false);
152	      utils.viewer.bookings.invalidate();
153	    },
154	    onError: (e) => {
155	      const errorMessages: Record<string, string> = {
156	        UNAUTHORIZED: t("you_are_unauthorized_to_make_this_change_to_the_booking"),
157	        BAD_REQUEST: e.message,
158	      };
159	
160	      const message = errorMessages[e.data?.code as string] || t("location_update_failed");
161	      showToast(message, "error");
162	    },
163	  });
164	
165	  const isUpcoming = new Date(booking.endTime) >= new Date();
166	  const isOngoing = isUpcoming && new Date() >= new Date(booking.startTime);
167	  const isBookingInPast = new Date(booking.endTime) < new Date();
168	  const isCancelled = booking.status === "CANCELLED";
169	  const isConfirmed = booking.status === "ACCEPTED";
170	  const isRejected = booking.status === "REJECTED";
171	  const isPending = booking.status === "PENDING";
172	  const isRescheduled = booking.fromReschedule !== null;
173	
174	  const getBookingStatus = (): "upcoming" | "past" | "cancelled" | "rejected" => {
175	    if (isCancelled) return "cancelled";
176	    if (isRejected) return "rejected";
177	    if (isBookingInPast) return "past";
178	    return "upcoming";
179	  };
180	
181	
182	  const userEmail = booking.loggedInUser.userEmail;
183	  const userSeat = booking.seatsReferences.find((seat) => !!userEmail && seat.attendee?.email === userEmail);
184	  const isAttendee = !!userSeat;
185	
186	  // Check if the logged-in user is the host/owner of the booking
187	  const isHost = booking.loggedInUser.userId === booking.user?.id;
188	
189	  const isCalVideoLocation =
190	    !booking.location ||
191	    booking.location === "integrations:daily" ||
192	    (typeof booking.location === "string" && booking.location.trim() === "");
193	
194	  const isDisabledCancelling = booking.eventType.disableCancelling;
195	  const isDisabledRescheduling = booking.eventType.disableRescheduling;
196	
197	  const getSeatReferenceUid = () => {
198	    return userSeat?.referenceUid;
199	  };
200	
201	  const saveLocation = async ({
202	    newLocation,
203	    credentialId,
204	  }: {
205	    newLocation: string;
206	    credentialId: number | null;
207	  }) => {
208	    try {
209	      await setLocationMutation.mutateAsync({
210	        bookingId: booking.id,
211	        newLocation,
212	        credentialId,
213	      });
214	    } catch {
215	      // Errors are shown through the mutation onError handler
216	    }
217	  };
218	
219	  // Calculate showPendingPayment based on payment logic
220	  const hasPayment = booking.payment.length > 0;
221	  const showPendingPayment = hasPayment;
222	
223	  const actionContext: BookingActionContext = {
224	    booking,
225	    isUpcoming,
226	    isOngoing,
227	    isBookingInPast,
228	    isCancelled,
229	    isConfirmed,
230	    isRejected,
231	    isPending,
232	    isRescheduled,
233	    isRecurring,
234	    isTabRecurring,
235	    isTabUnconfirmed,
236	    isDisabledCancelling,
237	    isDisabledRescheduling,
238	    isCalVideoLocation,
239	    showPendingPayment,
240	    isAttendee,
241	    cardCharged,
242	    attendeeList,
243	    getSeatReferenceUid,
244	    t,
245	  } as BookingActionContext;
246	
247	  const cancelEventAction = getCancelEventAction(actionContext);
248	  const showPastBookingCancelTooltip = isBookingInPast && cancelEventAction.disabled;
249	
250	  // Get pending actions (accept/reject) - only for details context
251	  const shouldShowPending = shouldShowPendingActions(actionContext);
252	  const basePendingActions =
253	    shouldShowPending && context === "details" ? getPendingActions(actionContext) : [];
254	  const pendingActions: ActionType[] = basePendingActions.map((action) => ({
255	    ...action,
256	    disabled: isConfirmPending,
257	    onClick:
258	      action.id === "confirm"
259	        ? () =>
260	            bookingConfirm({
261	              bookingId: booking.id,
262	              confirmed: true,
263	              recurringEventId: booking.recurringEventId,
264	            })
265	        : action.id === "reject"
266	          ? () => handleReject()
267	          : undefined,
268	  })) as ActionType[];
269	
270	  const shouldShowEdit = shouldShowEditActions(actionContext);
271	  const baseEditEventActions = getEditEventActions(actionContext);
272	  const editEventActions: ActionType[] = baseEditEventActions.map((action) => ({
273	    ...action,
274	    disabled: !shouldShowEdit || action.disabled, // Disable all edit actions if shouldn't show edit actions
275	    onClick:
276	      action.id === "reschedule_request"
277	        ? () => setIsOpenRescheduleDialog(true)
278	        : action.id === "change_location"
279	            ? () => setIsOpenLocationDialog(true)
280	            : action.id === "add_members"
281	              ? () => setIsOpenAddGuestsDialog(true)
282	              : action.id === "reassign"
283	                ? () => setIsOpenReassignDialog(true)
284	                : undefined,
285	  })) as ActionType[];
286	
287	  const baseAfterEventActions = getAfterEventActions(actionContext);
288	  const afterEventActions: ActionType[] = baseAfterEventActions.map((action) => ({
289	    ...action,
290	    onClick:
291	      action.id === "view_recordings"
292	        ? () => setViewRecordingsDialogIsOpen(true)
293	        : action.id === "meeting_session_details"
294	          ? () => setMeetingSessionDetailsDialogIsOpen(true)
295	          : action.id === "charge_card"
296	            ? () => setChargeCardDialogIsOpen(true)
297	            : action.id === "no_show"
298	              ? () => {
299	                  if (attendeeList.length === 1) {
300	                    const attendee = attendeeList[0];
301	                    noShowMutation.mutate({
302	                      bookingUid: booking.uid,
303	                      attendees: [{ email: attendee.email, noShow: !attendee.noShow }],
304	                    });
305	                    return;
306	                  }
307	                  setIsNoShowDialogOpen(true);
308	                }
309	              : undefined,
310	    disabled:
311	      action.disabled ||
312	      (action.id === "no_show" && !(isBookingInPast || isOngoing)) ||
313	      (action.id === "view_recordings" && !booking.isRecorded),
314	  })) as ActionType[];
315	
316	  const reportAction = getReportAction(actionContext);
317	  const reportActionWithHandler = {
318	    ...reportAction,
319	    onClick: () => setIsOpenReportDialog(true),
320	  };
321	
322	  const NoShowAttendeesDialog = ({
323	    bookingUid,
324	    attendees,
325	    setIsOpen,
326	    isOpen,
327	  }: {
328	    bookingUid: string;
329	    attendees: Array<{
330	      name: string;
331	      email: string;
332	      id: number;
333	      noShow: boolean;
334	      phoneNumber: string | null;
335	    }>;
336	    setIsOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
337	    isOpen: boolean;
338	  }) => {
339	    const [noShowAttendees, setNoShowAttendees] = useState<
340	      Array<{
341	        email: string;
342	        noShow: boolean;
343	      }>
344	    >(attendees.map((attendee) => ({ email: attendee.email, noShow: attendee.noShow })));
345	
346	    const noShowMutation = trpc.viewer.loggedInViewerRouter.markNoShow.useMutation({
347	      onSuccess: async (data) => {
348	        showToast(data.message, "success");
349	        setIsOpen(false);
350	        await utils.viewer.bookings.invalidate();
351	      },
352	      onError: (err) => {
353	        showToast(err.message, "error");
354	      },
355	    });
356	
357	    return (
358	      <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={setIsOpen}>
359	        <DialogContent title={t("mark_as_no_show")} enableOverflow>
360	          <div className="stack-y-2">
361	            {attendees.map((attendee, index) => (
362	              <label key={attendee.email} className="flex items-center space-x-2">
363	                <input
364	                  type="checkbox"
365	                  checked={noShowAttendees[index]?.noShow || false}
366	                  onChange={(e) => {
367	                    const newNoShowAttendees = [...noShowAttendees];
368	                    newNoShowAttendees[index] = {
369	                      email: attendee.email,
370	                      noShow: e.target.checked,
371	                    };
372	                    setNoShowAttendees(newNoShowAttendees);
373	                  }}
374	                />
375	                <span>
376	                  {attendee.name} ({attendee.email})
377	                </span>
378	              </label>
379	            ))}
380	          </div>
381	          <DialogFooter>
382	            <DialogClose />
383	            <Button
384	              onClick={() => {
385	                noShowMutation.mutate({
386	                  bookingUid,
387	                  attendees: noShowAttendees,
388	                });
389	              }}>
390	              {t("confirm")}
391	            </Button>
392	          </DialogFooter>
393	        </DialogContent>
394	      </Dialog>
395	    );
396	  };
397	
398	  const parsedBooking = {
399	    ...booking,
400	    eventType: booking.eventType.id ? booking.eventType : null,
401	  };
402	
403	  // Render dialogs that might be triggered from BookingListItem even if dropdown is not shown
404	  const dialogs = (
405	    <>
406	      <RescheduleDialog
407	        isOpenDialog={isOpenRescheduleDialog}
408	        setIsOpenDialog={setIsOpenRescheduleDialog}
409	        bookingUid={booking.uid}
410	      />
411	      {isOpenReassignDialog && (
412	        <ReassignDialog
413	          isOpenDialog={isOpenReassignDialog}
414	          setIsOpenDialog={setIsOpenReassignDialog}
415	          bookingId={booking.id}
416	          teamId={booking.eventType?.team?.id || 0}
417	          isManagedEvent={booking.eventType?.parentId != null}
418	        />
419	      )}
420	      <EditLocationDialog
421	        booking={booking}
422	        saveLocation={saveLocation}
423	        isOpenDialog={isOpenSetLocationDialog}
424	        setShowLocationModal={setIsOpenLocationDialog}
425	        teamId={booking.eventType?.team?.id}
426	      />
427	      <AddGuestsDialog
428	        isOpenDialog={isOpenAddGuestsDialog}
429	        setIsOpenDialog={setIsOpenAddGuestsDialog}
430	        bookingId={booking.id}
431	      />
432	      <ReportBookingDialog
433	        isOpenDialog={isOpenReportDialog}
434	        setIsOpenDialog={setIsOpenReportDialog}
435	        bookingUid={booking.uid}
436	        isRecurring={isRecurring}
437	        status={getBookingStatus()}
438	      />
439	      {booking.paid && booking.payment[0] && (
440	        <ChargeCardDialog
441	          isOpenDialog={chargeCardDialogIsOpen}
442	          setIsOpenDialog={setChargeCardDialogIsOpen}
443	          bookingId={booking.id}
444	          paymentAmount={booking.payment[0].amount}
445	          paymentCurrency={booking.payment[0].currency}
446	        />
447	      )}
448	      {/* Cal video recording dialogs removed (enterprise) */}
449	      {isNoShowDialogOpen && (
450	        <NoShowAttendeesDialog
451	          bookingUid={booking.uid}
452	          attendees={attendeeList}
453	          setIsOpen={setIsNoShowDialogOpen}
454	          isOpen={isNoShowDialogOpen}
455	        />
456	      )}
457	      <CancelBookingDialog
458	        isOpenDialog={isCancelDialogOpen}
459	        setIsOpenDialog={setIsCancelDialogOpen}
460	        booking={{
461	          uid: booking.uid,
462	          id: booking.id,
463	          title: booking.title,
464	          startTime: new Date(booking.startTime),
465	          payment: booking.payment,
466	        }}
467	        profile={{
468	          name: booking.user?.name || null,
469	          slug: booking.user?.username || null,
470	        }}
471	        recurringEvent={booking.eventType?.recurringEvent || null}
472	        team={booking.eventType?.team?.name}
473	        teamId={booking.eventType?.team?.id}
474	        allRemainingBookings={isTabRecurring && isRecurring}
475	        seatReferenceUid={getSeatReferenceUid()}
476	        currentUserEmail={booking.loggedInUser.userEmail}
477	        bookingCancelledEventProps={{
478	          booking: booking,
479	          organizer: {
480	            name: booking.user?.name || "Nameless",
481	            email: booking.userPrimaryEmail || booking.user?.email || "Email-less",
482	            timeZone: booking.user?.timeZone,
483	          },
484	          eventType: booking.eventType,
485	        }}
486	        isHost={isHost}
487	        internalNotePresets={[]}
488	        eventTypeMetadata={booking.eventType?.metadata}
489	      />
490	    </>
491	  );
492	
493	  // Check if there are any available actions across all action groups
494	  const hasAnyAvailableActions = () => {
495	    // Check if any pending action is available
496	    const hasAvailablePendingAction = pendingActions.some((action) => !action.disabled);
497	
498	    // Check if any edit action is available
499	    const hasAvailableEditAction = editEventActions.some((action) => !action.disabled);
500	
501	    // Check if any after event action is available
502	    const hasAvailableAfterAction = afterEventActions.some((action) => !action.disabled);
503	
504	    // Check report and cancel actions
505	    const isReportAvailable = !reportActionWithHandler.disabled;
506	    const isCancelAvailable = !cancelEventAction.disabled;
507	
508	    return (
509	      hasAvailablePendingAction ||
510	      hasAvailableEditAction ||
511	      hasAvailableAfterAction ||
512	      isReportAvailable ||
513	      isCancelAvailable
514	    );
515	  };
516	
517	  // Don't render dropdown if no actions are available
518	  if (!hasAnyAvailableActions()) {
519	    return dialogs;
520	  }
521	
522	  // Conditional portal wrapper to avoid portal when inside Sheet/Dialog
523	  const ConditionalPortal = usePortal
524	    ? DropdownMenuPortal
525	    : ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => <>{children}</>;
526	
527	  return (
528	    <>
529	      {dialogs}
530	      <RejectionReasonDialog
531	        isOpenDialog={rejectionDialogIsOpen}
532	        setIsOpenDialog={setRejectionDialogIsOpen}
533	        onConfirm={(reason) =>
534	          bookingConfirm({
535	            bookingId: booking.id,
536	            confirmed: false,
537	            recurringEventId: booking.recurringEventId,
538	            reason,
539	          })
540	        }
541	        isPending={isConfirmPending}
542	      />
543	      <Dropdown modal={false}>
544	        <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild data-testid="booking-actions-dropdown">
545	          <Button
546	            type="button"
547	            color="secondary"
548	            size={size}
549	            StartIcon="ellipsis"
550	            className={classNames("px-2", className)}
551	            // Prevent click from bubbling to parent row/container click handlers
552	            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
553	          />
554	        </DropdownMenuTrigger>
555	        <ConditionalPortal>
556	          <DropdownMenuContent>
557	            {pendingActions.length > 0 && (
558	              <>
559	                <DropdownMenuLabel className="px-2 pb-1 pt-1.5">{t("booking_response")}</DropdownMenuLabel>
560	                {pendingActions.map((action) => (
561	                  <DropdownMenuItem className="rounded-lg" key={action.id} disabled={action.disabled}>
562	                    <DropdownItem
563	                      type="button"
564	                      color={action.color}
565	                      StartIcon={action.icon}
566	                      href={action.disabled ? undefined : action.href}
567	                      disabled={action.disabled}
568	                      onClick={(e) => {
569	                        e.stopPropagation();
570	                        action.onClick?.(e);
571	                      }}
572	                      data-booking-uid={action.bookingUid}
573	                      data-testid={action.id}
574	                      className={action.disabled ? "text-muted" : undefined}>
575	                      {action.label}
576	                    </DropdownItem>
577	                  </DropdownMenuItem>
578	                ))}
579	                <DropdownMenuSeparator />
580	              </>
581	            )}
582	            <DropdownMenuLabel className="px-2 pb-1 pt-1.5">{t("edit_event")}</DropdownMenuLabel>
583	            {editEventActions.map((action) => (
584	              <DropdownMenuItem className="rounded-lg" key={action.id} disabled={action.disabled}>
585	                <DropdownItem
586	                  type="button"
587	                  color={action.color}
588	                  StartIcon={action.icon}
589	                  href={action.disabled ? undefined : action.href}
590	                  disabled={action.disabled}
591	                  onClick={(e) => {
592	                    e.stopPropagation();
593	                    action.onClick?.(e);
594	                  }}
595	                  data-booking-uid={action.bookingUid}
596	                  data-testid={action.id}
597	                  className={action.disabled ? "text-muted" : undefined}>
598	                  {action.label}
599	                </DropdownItem>
600	              </DropdownMenuItem>
601	            ))}
602	            <DropdownMenuSeparator />
603	            <DropdownMenuLabel className="px-2 pb-1 pt-1.5">{t("after_event")}</DropdownMenuLabel>
604	            {afterEventActions.map((action) => (
605	              <DropdownMenuItem className="rounded-lg" key={action.id} disabled={action.disabled}>
606	                <DropdownItem
607	                  type="button"
608	                  color={action.color}
609	                  StartIcon={action.icon}
610	                  href={action.disabled ? undefined : action.href}
611	                  onClick={(e) => {
612	                    e.stopPropagation();
613	                    action.onClick?.(e);
614	                  }}
615	                  disabled={action.disabled}
616	                  data-booking-uid={action.bookingUid}
```

```text
     1	import type { PrismaClient } from "@calcom/prisma";
     2	
     3	export type EventTypeFavoriteKey = { userId: number; eventTypeId: number };
     4	
     5	// manages all database actions for favoriting event types in one place
     6	export class EventTypeFavoriteRepository {
     7	
     8	  // taking in the database client lets tests pass in a fake client instead of a real database
     9	  constructor(private prismaClient: PrismaClient) {}
    10	
    11	  // adds a favorite for a user
    12	  // createMany + skipDuplicates ignores the second click instead of failing
    13	  async create({ userId, eventTypeId }: EventTypeFavoriteKey): Promise<void> {
    14	    await this.prismaClient.eventTypeFavorite.createMany({
    15	      data: [{ userId, eventTypeId }],
    16	      skipDuplicates: true,
    17	    });
    18	  }
    19	
    20	  // removes a favorite
    21	  // deleteMany doesn't throw when the row is already gone, unlike delete
    22	  async delete({ userId, eventTypeId }: EventTypeFavoriteKey): Promise<void> {
    23	    await this.prismaClient.eventTypeFavorite.deleteMany({
    24	      where: { userId, eventTypeId },
    25	    });
    26	  }
    27	
    28	  // gets a list of all event IDs favorited by the user
    29	  // only grabs events belonging to the user
    30	  // puts newest favorites first
    31	  async findEventTypeIdsByUserId(userId: number): Promise<number[]> {
    32	    const favorites = await this.prismaClient.eventTypeFavorite.findMany({
    33	      where: { userId },
    34	      select: { eventTypeId: true },
    35	      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    36	    });
    37	    return favorites.map((favorite) => favorite.eventTypeId);
    38	  }
    39	}

    10	export type SetFavoriteInput = { userId: number; eventTypeId: number; isFavorite: boolean };
    11	
    12	export class EventTypeFavoriteService {
    13	  constructor(private readonly deps: IEventTypeFavoriteServiceDeps) {}
    14	
    15	  async setFavorite({ userId, eventTypeId, isFavorite }: SetFavoriteInput): Promise<void> {
    16	    // if unstarring, remove it right away.
    17	    // no permission check is needed because you can only remove your own star
    18	    if (!isFavorite) {
    19	      await this.deps.eventTypeFavoriteRepository.delete({ userId, eventTypeId });
    20	      return;
    21	    }
    22	
    23	    // make sure the event exists and the user is actually allowed to see it
    24	
    25	    const hasAccess = await this.deps.eventTypeRepository.existsWithUserAccess({ id: eventTypeId, userId });
    26	    // say "Not found" whether the event is missing or private
    27	    if (!hasAccess) {
    28	      throw ErrorWithCode.Factory.EventTypeNotFound(`Event type ${eventTypeId} not found`);
    29	    }
    30	
    31	    // save the star. If someone double-clicks quickly, it safely ignores the second click
    32	    await this.deps.eventTypeFavoriteRepository.create({ userId, eventTypeId });
    33	  }
    34	
    35	  // gets the list of event IDs this user has starred, newest first
    36	  async listFavoriteIds({ userId }: { userId: number }): Promise<number[]> {
    37	    return this.deps.eventTypeFavoriteRepository.findEventTypeIdsByUserId(userId);
    38	  }
```

```text
436	                  {(provider?.label ||

438	                    locationToDisplay.startsWith("http") && (

440	                        href={locationToDisplay}
441	                        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
442	                        target="_blank"
443	                        title={locationToDisplay}
444	                        rel="noreferrer"

449	                              src={provider.iconUrl}

452	                              className="h-4 w-4 rounded-sm"

486	                recurringEventId={booking.recurringEventId}
487	                isRecurring={isRecurring}
488	                isTabRecurring={isTabRecurring}

503	              disabled={isActionDisabled("cancel", actionContext)}
504	              data-booking-uid={booking.uid}
505	              color="destructive">

507	            </Button>

509	          {isCancelled && booking.rescheduled && (
510	            <div className="hidden items-center md:flex">

512	            </div>
513	          )}
514	          {shouldShowIndividualReportButton(actionContext) && (

517	                type="button"
518	                variant="icon"
519	                color="destructive"

521	                onClick={reportActionWithHandler.onClick}

525	                tooltip={reportActionWithHandler.label}

530	        </div>
531	      </div>
532	      <BookingItemBadges
533	        booking={booking}
534	        isPending={isPending}
535	        isRejected={isRejected}
536	        recurringDates={recurringDates}
537	        userTimeFormat={userTimeFormat}
538	        userTimeZone={userTimeZone}
539	        isRescheduled={isRescheduled}
540	        onAssignmentReasonClick={undefined}
541	      />
542	    </div>
543	  );

545	
546	const BookingItemBadges = ({
547	  booking,
548	  isPending,
549	  isRejected,
550	  recurringDates,
551	  userTimeFormat,
552	  userTimeZone,
553	  isRescheduled,
554	  onAssignmentReasonClick,
555	}: {
556	  booking: BookingItemProps;
557	  isPending: boolean;
558	  isRejected: boolean;
559	  recurringDates: Date[] | undefined;
560	  userTimeFormat: number | null | undefined;
561	  userTimeZone: string | undefined;
562	  isRescheduled: boolean;
563	  onAssignmentReasonClick?: () => void;
564	}) => {
565	  const { t } = useLocale();
566	
567	  return (
568	    <div className="hidden h-9 flex-row items-center pb-4 pl-6 sm:flex">
569	      {isPending && (
570	        <Badge className="ltr:mr-2 rtl:ml-2" variant="orange">
571	          {t("unconfirmed")}
572	        </Badge>
573	      )}
574	      {isRescheduled && (
575	        <Tooltip content={`${t("rescheduled_by")} ${booking.rescheduler}`}>
576	          <Badge variant="orange" className="ltr:mr-2 rtl:ml-2">
577	            {t("rescheduled")}
578	          </Badge>
579	        </Tooltip>
580	      )}
581	      {isRejected && !isRescheduled && booking.assignmentReasonSortedByCreatedAt.length === 0 && (
582	        <Badge variant="gray" className="ltr:mr-2 rtl:ml-2">
583	          {t("rejected")}
584	        </Badge>
585	      )}
586	      {booking.eventType?.team && (
587	        <Badge className="ltr:mr-2 rtl:ml-2" variant="gray">
588	          {booking.eventType.team.name}
589	        </Badge>
590	      )}
591	      {booking?.assignmentReasonSortedByCreatedAt.length > 0 && (
592	        <AssignmentReasonTooltip
593	          assignmentReason={booking.assignmentReasonSortedByCreatedAt[booking.assignmentReasonSortedByCreatedAt.length - 1]}
594	          onClick={onAssignmentReasonClick}
595	        />
596	      )}
597	      {booking.report && (
598	        <Tooltip
599	          content={
600	            <div className="text-xs">
601	              {(() => {
602	                const reasonKey = `report_reason_${booking.report.reason.toLowerCase()}`;
603	                const reasonText = t(reasonKey);
604	                return booking.report.description
605	                  ? `${reasonText}: ${booking.report.description}`
606	                  : reasonText;
607	              })()}
608	            </div>
609	          }>
610	          <Badge className="ltr:mr-2 rtl:ml-2" variant="red">
611	            {t("reported")}
612	          </Badge>
613	        </Tooltip>
614	      )}
615	      {booking.paid && !booking.payment[0] ? (
616	        <Badge className="ltr:mr-2 rtl:ml-2" variant="orange">
617	          {t("error_collecting_card")}
618	        </Badge>
619	      ) : booking.paid ? (
620	        <Badge className="ltr:mr-2 rtl:ml-2" variant="green" data-testid="paid_badge">
621	          {booking.payment[0].paymentOption === "HOLD" ? t("card_held") : t("paid")}
622	        </Badge>
623	      ) : null}
624	      {recurringDates !== undefined && (
625	        <div className="text-muted -mt-1 text-sm">
626	          <RecurringBookingsTooltip
627	            userTimeFormat={userTimeFormat}
628	            userTimeZone={userTimeZone}
629	            booking={booking}
630	            recurringDates={recurringDates}
631	          />
632	        </div>
633	      )}
634	    </div>
635	  );
636	};
637	
638	interface RecurringBookingsTooltipProps {
639	  booking: BookingItemProps;
640	  recurringDates: Date[];
641	  userTimeZone: string | undefined;
642	  userTimeFormat: number | null | undefined;
643	}
644	
645	const RecurringBookingsTooltip = ({
646	  booking,
647	  recurringDates,
648	  userTimeZone,
649	  userTimeFormat,
650	}: RecurringBookingsTooltipProps) => {
651	  const {
652	    t,
653	    i18n: { language },
654	  } = useLocale();
655	  const now = new Date();
656	  const recurringCount = recurringDates.filter((recurringDate) => {
657	    return (
658	      recurringDate >= now &&
659	      !booking.recurringInfo?.bookings[BookingStatus.CANCELLED]
660	        .map((date) => date.toString())
661	        .includes(recurringDate.toString())
662	    );
663	  }).length;
664	
665	  return (
666	    (booking.recurringInfo &&
667	      booking.eventType?.recurringEvent?.freq != null &&
668	      (booking.listingStatus === "recurring" ||
669	        booking.listingStatus === "unconfirmed" ||
670	        booking.listingStatus === "cancelled") && (
671	        <div className="underline decoration-gray-400 decoration-dashed underline-offset-2">
672	          <div className="flex">
673	            <Tooltip
674	              content={recurringDates.map((aDate, key) => {
675	                const pastOrCancelled =
676	                  aDate < now ||
677	                  booking.recurringInfo?.bookings[BookingStatus.CANCELLED]
678	                    .map((date) => date.toString())
679	                    .includes(aDate.toString());
680	                return (
681	                  <p key={key} className={classNames(pastOrCancelled && "line-through")}>
682	                    {formatTime(aDate, userTimeFormat, userTimeZone)}
683	                    {" - "}
684	                    {dayjs(aDate).locale(language).format("D MMMM YYYY")}
685	                  </p>
686	                );
687	              })}>
688	              <div className="text-default">
689	                <Icon
690	                  name="refresh-ccw"
691	                  strokeWidth="3"
692	                  className="text-muted float-left mr-1 mt-1.5 inline-block h-3 w-3"
693	                />
694	                <p className="mt-1 pl-5 text-xs">
695	                  {booking.status === BookingStatus.ACCEPTED
696	                    ? `${t("event_remaining_other", {
697	                        count: recurringCount,
698	                      })}`
699	                    : getEveryFreqFor({
700	                        t,
701	                        recurringEvent: booking.eventType.recurringEvent,
702	                        recurringCount: booking.recurringInfo.count,
703	                      })}
704	                </p>
705	              </div>
706	            </Tooltip>
707	          </div>
708	        </div>
709	      )) ||
710	    null
711	  );
712	};
713	
714	interface UserProps {
715	  id: number;
716	  name: string | null;
717	  email: string;
718	}
719	
720	const FirstAttendee = ({
721	  user,
722	  currentEmail,
723	  hideOrganizerEmail,
724	}: {
725	  user: UserProps;
726	  currentEmail: string | null | undefined;
727	  hideOrganizerEmail?: boolean;
728	}) => {
729	  const { t } = useLocale();
730	  if (user.email === currentEmail) {
731	    return <div className="inline-block">{t("you")}</div>;
732	  }
733	  if (hideOrganizerEmail) {
734	    return <span className="inline-block">{user.name || ""}</span>;
735	  }
736	  return (
737	    <a
738	      key={user.email}
739	      className="hover:text-blue-500"
740	      href={`mailto:${user.email}`}
741	      onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
742	      {user.name || user.email}
743	    </a>
744	  );
745	};
746	
747	type NoShowProps = {
748	  bookingUid: string;
749	  isBookingInPast: boolean;
750	};
751	
752	const Attendee = (
753	  attendeeProps: BookingAttendee &
754	    NoShowProps & {
755	      hideOrganizerEmail?: boolean;
756	      organizerEmail?: string | null;
757	      eventTypeHosts?: Array<{ user: { email: string } | null }> | null;
758	    }
759	) => {
760	  const {
761	    email,
762	    name,
763	    bookingUid,
764	    isBookingInPast,
765	    noShow,
766	    phoneNumber,
767	    user,
768	    hideOrganizerEmail,
769	    organizerEmail,
770	    eventTypeHosts,
771	  } = attendeeProps;
772	  const { t } = useLocale();
773	
774	  const utils = trpc.useUtils();
775	  const [openDropdown, setOpenDropdown] = useState(false);
776	  const { copyToClipboard, isCopied } = useCopy();
777	
778	  const noShowMutation = trpc.viewer.loggedInViewerRouter.markNoShow.useMutation({
779	    onSuccess: async (data) => {
780	      showToast(data.message, "success");
781	      await utils.viewer.bookings.invalidate();
782	    },
783	    onError: (err) => {
784	      showToast(err.message, "error");
785	    },
786	  });
787	
788	  const displayName = user?.name || name || user?.email || email;
789	
790	  const isTeamMemberOrHost =
791	    email === organizerEmail || eventTypeHosts?.some((host) => host.user?.email === email);
792	  const shouldHideEmail = hideOrganizerEmail && isTeamMemberOrHost;
793	
794	  return (
795	    <Dropdown open={openDropdown} onOpenChange={setOpenDropdown}>
796	      <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
797	        <button
798	          data-testid="guest"
799	          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
800	          className="radix-state-open:text-blue-500 transition hover:text-blue-500">
801	          {noShow ? (
802	            <>
803	              {displayName} <Icon name="eye-off" className="inline h-4" />
804	            </>
805	          ) : (
806	            <>{displayName}</>
807	          )}
808	        </button>
809	      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
810	      <DropdownMenuPortal>
811	        <DropdownMenuContent>
812	          {!isSmsCalEmail(email) && !shouldHideEmail && (
813	            <DropdownMenuItem className="focus:outline-none">
814	              <DropdownItem
815	                StartIcon="mail"
816	                href={`mailto:${email}`}
817	                onClick={(e) => {
818	                  setOpenDropdown(false);
819	                  e.stopPropagation();
820	                }}>
821	                <a href={`mailto:${email}`}>{t("email")}</a>
822	              </DropdownItem>
823	            </DropdownMenuItem>
824	          )}
825	
826	          <DropdownMenuItem className="focus:outline-none">
827	            <DropdownItem
828	              StartIcon={isCopied ? "clipboard-check" : "clipboard"}
829	              onClick={(e) => {
830	                e.preventDefault();
831	                const isEmailCopied = isSmsCalEmail(email);
832	                copyToClipboard(isEmailCopied ? email : (phoneNumber ?? ""));
833	                setOpenDropdown(false);
834	                showToast(isEmailCopied ? t("email_copied") : t("phone_number_copied"), "success");
835	              }}>
836	              {!isCopied ? t("copy") : t("copied")}
837	            </DropdownItem>
838	          </DropdownMenuItem>
839	
840	          {isBookingInPast && (
```

```text
);

/**
 * Builds a booking link with query parameters
 * @param bookingUid - The unique identifier for the booking
 * @param allRemainingBookings - Whether to include all remaining bookings
 * @param email - Optional email of the attendee
 * @returns The formatted booking link with query parameters
 */
export function buildBookingLink({
  bookingUid,
  allRemainingBookings,
  email,
}: {
  bookingUid: string;
  allRemainingBookings: boolean;
  email?: string | null;
}): string {
  const urlSearchParams = new URLSearchParams({
    allRemainingBookings: allRemainingBookings.toString(),
  });
  if (email) {
    urlSearchParams.set("email", email);
  }
  return `/booking/${bookingUid}?${urlSearchParams.toString()}`;
}
```

```text
"use client";

import { ColumnFilterType, type SystemFilterSegment } from "@calcom/features/data-table";
import { useLocale } from "@calcom/lib/hooks/useLocale";
import classNames from "@calcom/ui/classNames";
import dynamic from "next/dynamic";
import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import { DataTableProvider } from "~/data-table/DataTableProvider";
import { useSegments } from "~/data-table/hooks/useSegments";
import { BookingListContainer } from "../components/BookingListContainer";
import { useActiveFiltersValidator } from "../hooks/useActiveFiltersValidator";
import { useBookingsView } from "../hooks/useBookingsView";
import type { validStatuses } from "../lib/validStatuses";

const BookingCalendarContainer = dynamic(() =>
  import("../components/BookingCalendarContainer").then((mod) => ({
    default: mod.BookingCalendarContainer,
  }))
);

type BookingsProps = {
  status: (typeof validStatuses)[number];
  userId?: number;
  permissions: {
    canReadOthersBookings: boolean;
  };
  bookingsV3Enabled: boolean;
  bookingAuditEnabled: boolean;
};

function useSystemSegments(userId?: number) {
  const { t } = useLocale();

  const systemSegments: SystemFilterSegment[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!userId) return [];

    return [
      {
        id: "my_bookings",
        name: t("my_bookings"),
        type: "system",
        activeFilters: [
          {
            f: "userId",
            v: {
              type: ColumnFilterType.MULTI_SELECT,
              data: [userId],
            },
          },
        ],
        perPage: 10,
      },
    ];
  }, [userId, t]);

  return systemSegments;
}

export default function Bookings(props: BookingsProps) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const systemSegments = useSystemSegments(props.userId);
  const validateActiveFilters = useActiveFiltersValidator({
    canReadOthersBookings: props.permissions.canReadOthersBookings,
  });
  if (!pathname) return null;
  return (
    <DataTableProvider
      tableIdentifier={pathname}
      useSegments={useSegments}
      systemSegments={systemSegments}
      validateActiveFilters={validateActiveFilters}>
      <BookingsContent {...props} />
    </DataTableProvider>
  );
}

function BookingsContent({ status, permissions, bookingsV3Enabled, bookingAuditEnabled }: BookingsProps) {
  const [view] = useBookingsView({ bookingsV3Enabled });

  return (
    <div className={classNames(view === "calendar" && "-mb-8")}>
      {view === "list" && (
        <BookingListContainer
          status={status}
          permissions={permissions}
          bookingsV3Enabled={bookingsV3Enabled}
          bookingAuditEnabled={bookingAuditEnabled}
        />
      )}
      {bookingsV3Enabled && view === "calendar" && (
        <BookingCalendarContainer
          status={status}
          permissions={permissions}
          bookingsV3Enabled={bookingsV3Enabled}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
